data.name: Settings.LlamaSharp.GpuLayersHelp
data.value: Enter 1–2147483647. Values above the model's layer count offload all available layers. Partial placement cannot be estimated reliably.

data.name: Settings.LlamaSharp.GpuLayersInvalid
data.value: Enter a whole number from 1 through 2147483647.

data.name: Settings.LlamaSharp.CudaEditionRequired
data.value: GPU layer overrides require the NVIDIA CUDA edition. The base edition preserves this value but ignores it. Install CUDA and restart to use it.
